excluded.sc_editMatrix: unsupported-missing-dependency: requires R package pheatmap, absent here
excluded.divide_bam: diverged-documented DIV-0017: the two builds use different RNG algorithms, so --seed assigns different query names to subsets. The gate compares the union of subsets (same partition), not per-file membership. Per-file equality is explicitly NOT claimed.
excluded.sc_bamStat: unsupported-input-shape: needs a single-cell BAM with CB/RE tags; bulk input makes both arms fail identically before doing work

stochastic_self_control.note: upstream subsamples reads per percentile with no RNG seed; two upstream runs on identical input differ

equivalence.note: upstream subsamples reads per percentile with no RNG seed; two upstream runs on identical input differ
